authoring: AI 撰寫的學習內容；詞形參考 ECDICT。非官方試題。

entries.en: temporary until final confirmation

examples.en: The team received provisional approval.
examples.zh: 團隊取得了暫定核准。

entries.en: showing a deep and useful understanding

examples.en: Her insightful comments improved the proposal.
examples.zh: 她富有洞見的意見改善了提案。

entries.en: done early to prevent a problem

examples.en: We took preemptive action against supply shortages.
examples.zh: 我們預先採取措施防止供貨短缺。

entries.en: designed for comfortable and efficient use

examples.en: An ergonomic chair can improve working comfort.
examples.zh: 符合人體工學的椅子能提升工作舒適度。

entries.en: stopping and starting at intervals

examples.en: We are experiencing intermittent network problems.
examples.zh: 我們正遇到間歇性的網路問題。

entries.en: never known or experienced before

examples.en: The sale attracted unprecedented demand.
examples.zh: 這次特賣帶來了前所未有的需求。

entries.en: relating to medicines and their production

examples.en: The firm supplies pharmaceutical packaging.
examples.zh: 這家公司供應藥品包裝。

entries.en: using the newest available technology

examples.en: The facility uses state-of-the-art equipment.
examples.zh: 這座設施使用最先進的設備。

entries.en: most important or leading in a field

examples.en: She is one of the foremost experts.
examples.zh: 她是頂尖專家之一。

entries.en: highly skilled through experience

examples.en: An accomplished designer led the project.
examples.zh: 一位經驗豐富的設計師領導了專案。

entries.en: operating in several countries

examples.en: The multinational firm opened a regional office.
examples.zh: 這家跨國企業開設了區域辦公室。

entries.en: away from the usual workplace

examples.en: The backup data is stored offsite.
examples.zh: 備份資料儲存在異地。

entries.en: not required to follow a particular rule

examples.en: Some purchases are exempt from this fee.
examples.zh: 部分採購免收這筆費用。

entries.en: in a way suited to the situation

examples.en: Demand increased, so we adjusted production accordingly.
examples.zh: 需求增加，因此我們相應調整了產量。

entries.en: in the end after other events

examples.en: The committee ultimately approved the plan.
examples.zh: 委員會最終核准了計畫。

entries.en: in the same order as previously mentioned

examples.en: Orders A and B arrive Monday and Tuesday, respectively.
examples.zh: 訂單 A 與 B 分別在星期一及星期二抵達。

entries.en: only for a particular person or purpose

examples.en: This offer is available exclusively to members.
examples.zh: 這項優惠僅限會員使用。

entries.en: with everyone in agreement

examples.en: The board unanimously approved the budget.
examples.zh: 董事會一致通過了預算。

entries.en: to rise and fall irregularly

examples.en: Exchange rates fluctuate throughout the day.
examples.zh: 匯率整天持續波動。

entries.en: to manage a program or carry out a procedure

examples.en: The department administers employee benefits.
examples.zh: 這個部門管理員工福利。

entries.en: to cause something to begin

examples.en: We initiated a review of supplier contracts.
examples.zh: 我們開始檢討供應商合約。

entries.en: to organize activities so they work together

examples.en: She coordinates deliveries between the two sites.
examples.zh: 她協調兩個據點之間的配送。

entries.en: to make previously private information known

examples.en: Applicants must disclose potential conflicts of interest.
examples.zh: 申請人必須揭露潛在的利益衝突。

entries.en: to take responsibility for managing work

examples.en: The director oversees regional operations.
examples.zh: 這位主管監督區域營運。

entries.en: to add something that improves another thing

examples.en: The new service complements our existing products.
examples.zh: 新服務與我們現有產品相輔相成。

entries.en: to notice or understand something in a particular way

examples.en: Customers perceive the brand as reliable.
examples.zh: 顧客認為這個品牌可靠。

entries.en: to act according to rules or requests

examples.en: All suppliers must comply with safety standards.
examples.zh: 所有供應商都必須遵守安全標準。

entries.en: to judge condition, value, or importance

examples.en: The team will assess the damage.
examples.zh: 團隊將評估損害。

entries.en: to discourage someone from an action

examples.en: Clear warnings help deter unauthorized access.
examples.zh: 清楚的警告有助於嚇阻未授權存取。

entries.en: to willingly accept a new idea or change

examples.en: The team embraced the new workflow.
examples.zh: 團隊欣然接受了新工作流程。

entries.en: to successfully reach a level or goal

examples.en: She attained the required language level.
examples.zh: 她達到了所需的語言程度。

entries.en: to control through rules or adjustments

examples.en: The device regulates room temperature.
examples.zh: 這個裝置調節室內溫度。

entries.en: to make a process happen more quickly

examples.en: We paid extra to expedite delivery.
examples.zh: 我們加付費用以加快配送。

entries.en: to formally ask for something

examples.en: We are soliciting feedback from customers.
examples.zh: 我們正在徵求顧客意見。

entries.en: to use something fully or unfairly

examples.en: The company exploited a new market opportunity.
examples.zh: 公司善用了新的市場機會。

entries.en: to deliberately hold back something

examples.en: The client withheld payment pending repairs.
examples.zh: 客戶在修繕完成前暫緩付款。

entries.en: to change how an organization is arranged

examples.en: The company restructured its sales division.
examples.zh: 公司重組了業務部門。

entries.en: to make records or differences agree

examples.en: Please reconcile the bank statements monthly.
examples.zh: 請每月核對銀行對帳單。

entries.en: to collect information into a single work

examples.en: We compiled the survey results into a report.
examples.zh: 我們將調查結果彙整成報告。

entries.en: to give someone a right to something

examples.en: Membership entitles you to free delivery.
examples.zh: 會員資格使你享有免費配送。

entries.en: to encourage something to develop

examples.en: The program fosters cooperation between departments.
examples.zh: 這項計畫促進部門間的合作。

entries.en: to use something effectively

examples.en: We utilize the extra space for storage.
examples.zh: 我們將多餘空間用於儲物。

entries.en: to combine things into a stronger whole

examples.en: We consolidated several orders into one shipment.
examples.zh: 我們將幾筆訂單整合為一批出貨。

entries.en: to identify and solve technical problems

examples.en: The technician will troubleshoot the connection issue.
examples.zh: 技術人員將排除連線問題。

entries.en: to reduce spending or resource use

examples.en: We need to economize on travel expenses.
examples.zh: 我們需要節省差旅費。

entries.en: to do better than a level or expectation

examples.en: Sales surpassed last year's total.
examples.zh: 銷售額超過了去年的總額。

entries.en: to help opposing parties reach agreement

examples.en: A consultant mediated the contract dispute.
examples.zh: 顧問調解了合約爭議。

entries.en: to officially take something away

examples.en: Customs officers confiscated the prohibited goods.
examples.zh: 海關人員沒收了違禁品。

entries.en: to separate or stop being involved

examples.en: Disengage the lock before opening the cover.
examples.zh: 打開護蓋前請先解除鎖定。

entries.en: to achieve a goal or follow someone in a role

examples.en: The new campaign succeeded in attracting subscribers.
examples.zh: 新活動成功吸引了訂戶。

entries.en: to increase in seriousness or refer upward

examples.en: Escalate unresolved complaints to a supervisor.
examples.zh: 請將未解決的客訴呈報主管。

entries.en: to explain using examples or images

examples.en: The chart illustrates monthly sales trends.
examples.zh: 圖表說明了每月銷售趨勢。

entries.en: to reduce the size of an organization

examples.en: The firm downsized its regional office.
examples.zh: 這家公司縮編了區域辦公室。

entries.en: to assign resources to a different purpose

examples.en: We reallocated funds to urgent repairs.
examples.zh: 我們將經費重新分配給緊急修繕。

entries.en: to become responsible for costs or losses

examples.en: Late cancellations may incur a fee.
examples.zh: 逾時取消可能產生費用。

entries.en: to publicly support a policy or idea

examples.en: The group advocates safer working conditions.
examples.zh: 這個團體倡議更安全的工作環境。

entries.en: to bring people together for a meeting

examples.en: The board will convene on Monday.
examples.zh: 董事會將在星期一開會。

entries.en: to include a wide range of things

examples.en: The program encompasses training and ongoing support.
examples.zh: 這項計畫涵蓋訓練與持續支援。

entries.en: to distribute information widely

examples.en: The agency disseminates updates to all branches.
examples.zh: 該機構向所有分支單位發布最新資訊。

entries.en: to value something or increase in value

examples.en: We appreciate your prompt assistance.
examples.zh: 我們感謝你的迅速協助。

entries.en: to give official permission

examples.en: Only managers can authorize this payment.
examples.zh: 只有經理可以核准這筆付款。

entries.en: to reduce or limit something

examples.en: The company curtailed unnecessary travel.
examples.zh: 公司減少了不必要的差旅。

entries.en: to serve as a clear example

examples.en: Her work exemplifies our commitment to quality.
examples.zh: 她的工作體現了我們對品質的承諾。

entries.en: to lose value over time

examples.en: Office equipment depreciates over several years.
examples.zh: 辦公設備會在數年間逐漸折舊。

entries.en: to publicly support or approve something

examples.en: The association endorsed the training program.
examples.zh: 協會認可了這項訓練計畫。

entries.en: to build up gradually over time

examples.en: Interest accrues on the unpaid balance.
examples.zh: 未清償餘額會持續產生利息。

entries.en: to make harm or risk less severe

examples.en: Extra inventory helps mitigate supply disruptions.
examples.zh: 額外庫存有助於減輕供貨中斷的影響。

entries.en: to become worse

examples.en: The equipment's condition deteriorated over time.
examples.zh: 設備狀況隨時間惡化。

entries.en: to make a process easier

examples.en: The new portal facilitates online registration.
examples.zh: 新平台讓線上報名更便利。

entries.en: to obtain a response through questions or actions

examples.en: The survey elicited useful customer feedback.
examples.zh: 調查引出了實用的顧客回饋。

entries.en: to formally end something

examples.en: Either party may terminate the agreement.
examples.zh: 任一方都可以終止協議。

entries.en: to put resources or systems into use

examples.en: We deployed the update to all branches.
examples.zh: 我們將更新部署到所有分公司。

entries.en: to pay part of the cost

examples.en: The company subsidizes employee training.
examples.zh: 公司補助員工訓練費用。

entries.en: to hire an outside business to do work

examples.en: We outsourced the packaging design.
examples.zh: 我們將包裝設計委外處理。

entries.en: to begin an activity

examples.en: Construction will commence next month.
examples.zh: 工程將於下個月開始。

entries.en: to make something work as well as possible

examples.en: The team optimized the delivery routes.
examples.zh: 團隊最佳化了配送路線。

entries.en: to depart from a plan or standard

examples.en: Do not deviate from the approved procedure.
examples.zh: 請勿偏離核准的程序。

entries.en: to officially choose a person or purpose

examples.en: Please designate a contact person.
examples.zh: 請指定一位聯絡人。

entries.en: to find a way through a place or system

examples.en: Users can easily navigate the new website.
examples.zh: 使用者可以輕鬆瀏覽新網站。

entries.en: to slow down or prevent progress

examples.en: Missing documents may impede approval.
examples.zh: 文件缺漏可能妨礙核准。

entries.en: to develop a plan carefully

examples.en: We formulated a strategy for expansion.
examples.zh: 我們制定了擴張策略。

entries.en: to pay someone back for expenses

examples.en: The company will reimburse approved travel costs.
examples.zh: 公司會報銷核准的差旅費。

entries.en: to turn something into a source of income

examples.en: The platform helps creators monetize their work.
examples.zh: 這個平台協助創作者將作品變現。

entries.en: to say something again for emphasis

examples.en: The manager reiterated the safety requirements.
examples.zh: 經理重申了安全要求。

entries.en: to make a problem or discomfort less severe

examples.en: Extra staff helped alleviate the workload.
examples.zh: 增派人員有助於減輕工作負擔。

entries.en: to sell assets to obtain cash or settle debts

examples.en: The company liquidated its surplus stock.
examples.zh: 公司變賣了多餘庫存。

entries.en: to communicate between people or organizations

examples.en: She liaises with suppliers about delivery dates.
examples.zh: 她就交貨日期與供應商協調。

entries.en: to involve something as a necessary part

examples.en: The position entails frequent overseas travel.
examples.zh: 這個職位需要經常海外出差。

entries.en: to select candidates for final consideration

examples.en: We shortlisted five applicants for interviews.
examples.zh: 我們挑選五位應徵者進入面試。

entries.en: to produce a result or return

examples.en: The investment yielded a steady return.
examples.zh: 這項投資帶來了穩定收益。

entries.en: to balance an effect with an opposite benefit

examples.en: Higher sales offset the increased costs.
examples.zh: 較高的銷售額抵消了增加的成本。

entries.en: to send someone or something to a destination

examples.en: We dispatched the replacement parts today.
examples.zh: 我們今天寄出了替換零件。

entries.en: to rise suddenly and strongly

examples.en: Online orders surged after the campaign.
examples.zh: 活動後網路訂單激增。

entries.en: to allow another business to use a brand

examples.en: The company plans to franchise its café concept.
examples.zh: 公司計畫開放咖啡店品牌加盟。

entries.en: to judge an amount or situation

examples.en: The survey will gauge customer satisfaction.
examples.zh: 這份調查將衡量顧客滿意度。

entries.en: to use an advantage to achieve a result

examples.en: We leveraged our experience to enter new markets.
examples.zh: 我們善用經驗開拓新市場。

entries.en: to lose a right or payment by breaking a condition

examples.en: You may forfeit your deposit by canceling late.
examples.zh: 逾時取消可能使你喪失訂金。

entries.en: to formally introduce a system or rule

examples.en: The company instituted new safety checks.
examples.zh: 公司實施了新的安全檢查。

entries.en: to consider something the cause of a result

examples.en: We attribute our success to teamwork.
examples.zh: 我們將成功歸功於團隊合作。

entries.en: to review an event after it has happened

examples.en: The team will debrief after the conference.
examples.zh: 團隊將在會議後進行檢討。
